design_philosophy.identity: The Midnight Bistro vs. The Flight Deck
design_philosophy.core_concept: A dual-interface system. The customer side is a seductive, dark-mode luxury experience evoking the feeling of a high-end late-night French bistro. The staff side is a high-contrast, military-grade 'Control Room' for maximum efficiency.

usage_rules.headings: Use 'DM Serif Display' for all H1-H3. Tracking tight (-0.02em). Weight: 400 (Regular) is usually enough due to the font's nature.
usage_rules.body: Use 'Manrope' for all UI text, menus, and descriptions. Excellent legibility on mobile.
usage_rules.numbers: Use 'JetBrains Mono' for prices, timers (KDS), and order IDs to ensure tabular alignment.

typography.installation: Import via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Serif+Display&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&family=Manrope:wght@300;400;600;800&display=swap');

rules: Hero section must be 85vh with bottom-aligned text.
Navigation bar is 'Sticky Bottom' or 'Floating Island' at bottom for thumb reachability.
Product cards use 'Bento' grid: 1 large feature + 2 small sides.
100% width/height utilization. No scroll if possible.
Cards are 'State Machines': Color changes based on status (New=Flash, Cooking=Yellow, Ready=Green).
Touch targets must be minimum 64px height.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-full font-bold tracking-wide shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(245,158,11,0.3)]

cards.product: bg-card border-border/50 border overflow-hidden rounded-2xl shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 group
cards.kds_ticket: rounded-lg border-2 border-dashed border-muted-foreground/20 p-4 flex flex-col gap-2 h-full

inputs.style: bg-input/50 border-transparent focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-xl h-12

visual_enhancers.gradients: Use subtle radial gradients behind hero images: 'bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_center,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-amber-500/20 via-transparent to-transparent'
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle noise texture overlay on the dark background to prevent banding and add 'film grain' feel.

instructions_to_main_agent.file_handling: You are working with .js/.jsx files. Do not use TypeScript syntax. Ensure all imports resolve correctly.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_implementation: Update /app/frontend/src/index.css with the provided CSS variables immediately. This is the foundation.
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_customization: When using Shadcn components, override the default 'rounded-md' with 'rounded-xl' or 'rounded-2xl' to match the friendly/premium vibe.
instructions_to_main_agent.kds_logic: For the Kitchen Dashboard, prioritize INFORMATION DENSITY. Do not use the 'luxury' spacing rules there. Use 'p-2' or 'p-3' to fit more tickets.
instructions_to_main_agent.mobile_nav: Implement a bottom navigation bar for mobile users (Home, Menu, Cart, Profile). Hide it on Desktop.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements.
Use glass-morphism effects for floating elements.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (except in KDS).
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
